title: Magnetic graphene nanocomposites: a new frontier in radioactive waste remediation

Explore the potential of magnetic graphene nanocomposites for radioactive waste treatment. This review details their synthesis strategies, physicochemical properties, and mechanisms for efficient radionuclide sequestration.
